notes:
510 E 62nd St 10065 - (212) 838-8100 - 24/7, the major NYC specialty/ER hospital.

510 East 62nd St (btwn FDR & York), NY 10065. ER (212) 838-8100; appts (212) 838-7053. amcny.org. Open 24h; NYC's largest specialty + ER hospital.

Charlie's Patient Assistance Fund (free/subsidized EMERGENCY care), Buddy Fund (cancer), Cooper Fund (radiation), SAVE (seniors 65+), plus military/adopted-pet discounts. Pet must be seen at AMC; apply within 5 business days of treatment. funds@amcny.org - (212) 838-8100 - amcny.org/financial-assistance.

Charlie's Patient Assistance Fund (free/subsidized EMERGENCY care), Buddy Fund (cancer), Cooper Fund (radiation), SAVE (seniors 65+), plus military/adopted-pet discounts. Pet must be seen at AMC; apply within 5 business days of treatment. funds@amcny.org, (212) 838-8100, amcny.org/financial-assistance.

Honey Bunny and Rou Fund: subsidized SPECIALTY care specifically for RABBITS (and German Shepherds) of owners with limited means. One pet per household per 12 months. Pet must first be seen by an AMC vet; apply within 5 business days of starting treatment; tri-state residency (NY/NJ/CT); no outstanding AMC balance; can't hold another AMC grant. funds@amcny.org, (212) 838-8100, amcny.org/financial-assistance.

Kiki White Umbrella Cockatoo Avian Fund: subsidizes specialty care for ALL BIRDS of families with limited means. Same rules as above (AMC exam first, 5-business-day deadline, tri-state, one pet per household per 12 months). This is one of the very few bird-specific vet funds anywhere. funds@amcny.org.

Charlie's Patient Assistance Fund (emergency care, any species), the Buddy Fund (cancer, any species), the Monty and Minny Fund (rehabilitation), and SAVE (owners 65+): all open to exotic pets under the same eligibility rules. Start with AMC's Eligibility Application at amcny.org/financial-assistance (income threshold about $50k/household).
